note: Illustrations plus claires : les mouvements complexes (arraché, épaulé, muscle-up, burpee, Turkish get-up…) s'affichent en 3 ou 4 images, et les étirements dont les deux images se ressemblaient ont été refaits.
note_en: Clearer illustrations: complex lifts (snatch, clean, muscle-up, burpee, Turkish get-up…) now show 3 or 4 frames, and stretches whose two images looked alike were redrawn.
note_tr: Daha net çizimler: karmaşık hareketler (koparma, silkme, muscle-up, burpee, Turkish get-up…) artık 3 veya 4 karede gösteriliyor; iki resmi birbirine benzeyen esnemeler yeniden çizildi.
